acceptance_checks.detail: Original AutoSci native skill document exists.
Solar feature parity route declares a backend action.
Solar preserves the native $exp-status experiment/pipeline status surface and routes it through monitor_experiment.
The local status proof resolves exp-local-default from Solar-managed wiki experiment state and reports completed state without schema-only fallback.
$exp-status remains side-effect-free for local wiki/run-state status reads and does not mutate native AutoSci state.
Native server configuration is remote-only; the local status proof reads wiki/run-state evidence without remote/provider configuration.
Local status evidence is not counted as live SSH/provider polling; live remote/provider status remains optional remote-mode proof.

findings.finding: $exp-status is semantically full for local wiki/run-state status reads represented by the supplied Phase 19 evidence.
Live remote/provider polling remains intentionally out of scope for this local assessment and must not block local status parity.

limitations: Local status parity covers wiki/run-state lookup, local session registry status, supplied approved runtime evidence, collect-ready detection, and local collection identity evidence without requiring remote/provider configuration. `$exp-status` emits an explicit remote poll boundary so local run-dir status-file checks are not counted as live SSH/provider polling; live SSH/provider polling, approved provider status commands, and distributed exactly-once remote collection remain optional remote-mode follow-up proof.

summary: Solar $exp-status preserves native AutoSci local status semantics for wiki/run-state lookup after a local experiment run: it resolves the requested experiment id without default fallback, reads Solar-managed wiki experiment state, reports completed state and evidence ids, remains side-effect-free, and does not require remote/provider configuration. Live SSH/provider polling remains optional remote-mode proof and is not a local status blocker.
